rules.name: DAHAN TRUST THE WATCHERS
rules.text: After one of your Powers adds Defend to a single land, Gather up to 1 [Dahan] into that land. ("Power" includes both your Innate Power and your Power Cards. Can be used with any number of Defend Powers each turn.)
rules.turn:
turn, >add-defend S P L N, spirit:special S dahan-trust-the-watchers
  ~gather-up-to-1 L dahan
rules.evidence: add-defend eyes watchful l3 2; defend l3 2; gather-up-to-1 l3 dahan; a Dahan moves l2 -> l3; count l3 dahan 1 (all 4 seeds).
rules.notes: Needed the base to make 'a Power adds Defend' an attributed step (add-defend S P L N) rather than only the anonymous defend L N sum, so 'one of your Powers' can be recognized. 'to a single land' is not distinguished (every Defend in the slice is single-land; would need a power:single-land fact). 'up to 1' = a decline option in the Gather choice domain.

base_ext: add-defend S P L N step for a Power's Defend (feeding core's defend L N for the rest of the turn via `turn, >add-defend …, ^defend L N`); Gather up to 1 of a kind from adjacent lands with a decline option.
language_issues: Triggers on 'your Power does X' need X to be an episode carrying the actor; core's anonymous defend L N tuple was not enough, so the actor-tagged step had to be introduced in BASE-EXT.
